introduction: North Dakota unemployment claims start in UI ICE. File during the week unemployment begins; the agency says claims cannot be backdated.
description: North Dakota unemployment claims start in UI ICE. File during the week unemployment begins; the agency says claims cannot be backdated.

sections.who: Job Service reviews covered earnings and the reason work ended or hours decreased. Ongoing eligibility includes being able and available for work and meeting assigned work-search requirements.
sections.get: Approved benefits provide temporary payments for eligible weeks. An initial application alone does not request every weekly payment.
sections.docs:
• Identity and employment information.
  • Employer contacts, work dates and separation details.
  • Weekly earnings and job-search records.
sections.apply:
1. File the initial claim

    Use Job Service’s current filing instructions to reach UI ICE.

  2. Monitor claim tasks

    Check My To-Do List and respond to verification or eligibility requests.

  3. Certify weekly

    Submit each weekly request through UI ICE or the agency’s automated telephone route.
sections.after: Report earnings and availability accurately. If you miss filing, contact Job Service about reopening and the affected weeks rather than assuming the account remains active.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Initial claim rules, Weekly certifications and claim tasks. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can I wait and claim earlier weeks later?
The state says claims are effective for the filing week and cannot be backdated.
Is there a weekly telephone option?
The agency lists its automated system at 701-328-4995, using the required PIN.
Where do I find outstanding tasks?
UI ICE provides a My To-Do List for claim actions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
